sources.title: Building Supergravity Quintessence Model

evidence.text: A hidden strongly interacting sector is used to generate a dark-energy scale from the electroweak and Planck scales while furnishing an axion with the shift symmetry needed by the supergravity construction.

sources.title: De Sitter vs Quintessence in String Theory

evidence.text: Can an ultralight periodic axion provide evolving dark energy when its potential minimum is not fixed to zero? Hubble friction delays motion until H approaches the axion mass, while the initial phase and vacuum offset affect subsequent evolution.

sources.title: Building Supergravity Quintessence Model

evidence.text: Retain the dominant coefficient products, stabilize the imaginary component, integrate the real-line kinetic metric, and rewrite the rational potential in a hyperbolic coordinate. The real kinetic normalization must be checked before applying standard scalar cosmology formulas.

sources.title: De Sitter vs Quintessence in String Theory

evidence.text: Fix the model and metric, partition field space by hierarchies, estimate potential and gradient terms, inspect dangerous loci, and combine valid lower bounds. Appendix A uses μ ≪ v and bounded φ; its χ domain and Λ–Λ̃ relationship remain unknown.

sources.title: Axion Hilltops, Kahler Modulus Quintessence and the Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: Restore the fields controlling a partial potential, verify their background-dependent EFT status, and compute full-field forces before classifying an extremum. This abstracts the paper's axion–modulus procedure while retaining its missing-metric and cutoff limitations.

sources.title: Building Supergravity Quintessence Model

evidence.text: Stabilize the hidden and real scalar directions, retain the term linear in W1, and choose its real part to reproduce a target potential. A local analytic continuation supplies a concrete implementation when the target permits one.

sources.title: De Sitter vs Quintessence in String Theory

evidence.text: Phenomenological multi-field potentials are assessed through gradient-to-potential ratios and parametric/numerical field-region checks. Ultra-light axions are studied using a leading nonperturbative cosine potential and a slow-roll condition.

sources.title: De Sitter vs Quintessence in String Theory

evidence.text: Four-dimensional F-term supergravity, no-scale cancellation, and competing perturbative/nonperturbative expansions organize moduli stabilization: KKLT tunes the flux superpotential, whereas LVS balances effects involving different moduli and expansion parameters.

sources.title: Cosmic birefringence from monodromic axion dark energy

evidence.text: A homogeneous ultralight axion can act as potential-dominated dark energy and rotate photon polarization through a Chern–Simons interaction. Its mass and photon coupling are independent effective parameters.
